$schema_note: Hand-curated record of how Hero Siege announces a rare ground drop in chat, for ForgePact#17 (Loot announcements). NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file. Every `status` is `static_reading` (read from the compiled game locally and paraphrased in our own words; no script text is kept anywhere) until a ForgePact#17 live session records a `measured` value. `scripts` is the announcement chain by SDK name, in call order; `rarity_key` is the itemInfoStruct key holding the rarity (docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md section 16.4, measured); `rarity_codes_announced_online` lists the rarity codes the game's own online path announces and what decides each; `route` is the call ForgePact's `lootann` ships to show the line offline, `null` until Live procedure 1 picks one (one of `method`, `netsend`, `chatadd`, `server`). The argument is ForgePact docs/loot-announcement-research.md; the shared facts are docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md sections 8.6 and 16.10.
